summary.text: Scott Oelslager is serving his fourth term in the Ohio House of Representatives for District 48, which includes portions of Stark County, after serving multiple terms in both the Senate and House previously. He chairs the House Financial Institutions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before his legislative career, Oelslager worked as an aide to Congressman Ralph Regula and later as director of public relations for Malone College.

He was appointed to the Ohio Senate in 1985 and returned by Stark County voters for four additional terms, then was elected to the Ohio House in 2002, where he chaired the Judiciary Committee and the Civil and Commercial Law Committee.
Stark County voters again elected him to the Senate in 2010, and he was elected to the newly formed 29th Senate District in 2014.
Oelslager received his bachelor's degree from Mount Union and his law degree from Capital University Law School, and lives in North Canton with his wife, Elsie.
